title: Fix Dead Universitäten Bridge Slide
description: Presentation slide #/0/7?folie=Universitäten is a dead morph bridge showing step-1 affiliations instead of universities. Extend morphBridgeDirect for affiliation and author step transitions.
summary:
Removed dead morph bridge slides before intro affiliation steps 2 and 3.

- Extended `morphBridgeDirect` so consecutive `marked-affiliations-step*` author embodiments and `step*` affiliation embodiments morph in one reveal.js auto-animate step without an intermediate bridge.
- `#/0/7?folie=Universitäten` now lands on the real `affiliations-2` slide showing LUH and UdK (no duplicate bridge bookmark at the same index).
- Updated German URL hash test and added regression test for single Universities bookmark at v=7.

All `@semio-tech/framework-presentation-core` and renderer tests pass.
